title: Chicken Breasts Stuffed with Prosciutto & Cheese
description: Upgrade your chicken breast by stuffing them with prosciutto and cheese. This stuffed chicken recipe features gooey mozzarella, herb pesto, and perfectly savory Italian ham. Best of all, it’s ready in 30 minutes. Using simple ingredients like chicken, cheese, and deli meat, this prosciutto and cheese stuffed chicken is yummy — and super easy to make.
ingredients: 1 ½ to 2 lbs chicken breasts – 4 good sized breasts
12 mozzarella cheese sticks (cut up or buy already wrapped with prosciutto)
directions: Wrap each mozzarella cheese stick with a piece of prosciutto. Set aside.
Slice a pocket into the side of each chicken breast horizontally. Insert 1-3 prosciutto wrapped mozzarella sticks inside and secure with toothpicks.
Make a little mix of breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, and softened butter.
In a large skillet add the olive oil and butter over medium heat.
Season each chicken breast on both sides with salt and pepper, sprinkle with a little flour.
Brown on each side for several minutes. Remove from the heat.
Turn the breasts with the former skin (shinny side) down and press the bread-cheese mixture into the surfaces.
Add some white wine, broth, and chopped onions to the pan, scraping up anything stuck to the bottom.
Put the pan in the oven and cook for about 10 minutes or until internal temperature is at least 160°F.
Remove toothpicks and serve (optionally topped with a spoonful of pesto). Spoon pan juices over all (and maybe with some noodle pasta).
